thread:
alex: Follow-up thread for the KV OOM cascade last night (clusters eu-1 & us-west-2). Observed pattern: slow slab reclamation + tombstone accumulation after a rapid delete burst. Spawning this to track owners and concrete short/medium-term actions.

jordan: summary of observed signals: incremental rise in per-shard "residency" over 6h, sudden jump at 02:12 UTC with three shards hitting hard limits. Heap snapshots: snap-2026-04-12-0215 (GCS3). Fragmentation map attached to the PM doc.

maya: quick read: there are two distinct contributors - (A) long-lived tombstones that don't hit the sweeping window because of the current GC sampling cadence, (B) slab fragmentation from many small value churn ops that cause large free spans to be unusable.

liam: immediate mitigations we can roll tonight (low-risk):
- increase per-shard soft_limit by 15% (config flag kv.soft_limit_shard)
- enable tombstone-sweep-immediate for partitions with delete-rate > 200/s (config flag kv.tombstone_sweep_immediate)
I'll own the rollout and rollback. Canary target: canary pool in 4 hours.

sophie: i'll prep the config PR and add a smoke healthcheck. Healthcheck: fail if OOMs >0 or 95th p99 latency degrades >30% over 10m. I'll include instructions for immediate rollback and a quick dataplane toggle in the console.

alex: medium-term items (owners + rough timeline):
- continuous lightweight allocation tracing (owner: maya) - prototype by 2026-04-21
- slab defragmenter job (owner: liam) - PoC by 2026-04-26; must be opt-in per cluster
- GC cadence tuning and evaluation (owner: jordan) - plan + experiment infra by 2026-04-19
- per-shard "tombstone_age" metric and eviction-miss counter surfaced to console (owner: sophie) - dashboard + alert by 2026-04-17

maya: note on tracing: keep overhead <1.5% CPU and sampled per shard at 1s windows. We'll emit residency percentiles and median tombstone age.

liam: defrag job sketch: run a bounded compaction sweep on flagged shards (flagging rule: frag_ratio > 2.2 and free-span fragmentation score > 0.7). Must throttle to avoid CPU spikes.

ops-bot: Incident linked: INC-2026-0412-KV-LEAK; severity S2; reminders set for owners 72h before due dates.

alex: recurring detection: i'll add an alerting query that triggers if >2 shards experience >1.5x baseline residency growth within 24h. It will auto-open a follow-up thread like this one. Owner: alex, cadence: weekly review + auto-trigger.

sophie: risk callout: tombstone_sweep_immediate may increase short-term CPU and IO. Add CPU headroom check to canary (fail canary if CPU > 75% for 3m).

jordan: agree. Also we should add an eviction-probe test in staging that simulates delete bursts and measures reclaim latency. Owner: liam, deliverable: test harness by 2026-04-18.

maya: adding a regression guard: post-merge CI job that runs the eviction-probe in a small cluster and verifies tombstone_age reduces by >40% under the same synthetic workload.

liam: timeline recap and owners (compact):
- immediate config PR + canary (liam + sophie): deploy tonight -> canary results within 4h
- eviction-probe harness (liam): 2026-04-18
- GC tuning experiment (jordan): 2026-04-19
- metrics & dashboard (sophie): 2026-04-17
- tracing prototype (maya): 2026-04-21
- defrag PoC (liam): 2026-04-26

alex: i will update the PM postmortem with this checklist and ping owners. Link: https://redwood-internal/pm/kv-oom-2026-04-12 (section 'Follow-ups - action rotation').

sophie: PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/kv/3812 with runbook attached. Will post canary status here once started.

liam: starting canary now on the canary pool. posting logs in 30m.

maya: thanks all. If the canary looks green, let's schedule the GC A/B plan after two successful canary windows.

jordan: closing this thread for now. Reopen with results or blockers. Keep comments short and actionable. :white_check_mark:
